home.title: Good things deserve <accent>a way in.</accent>
home.description: Create, share, and manage access to your products. One home for redemption codes, discounts, and software licenses.
home.logosTitle: Works with the tools you already use
home.featuresTitle: From a code to a customer.
home.featuresBody: Everything you need to issue, sell and track codes, without building it yourself.

inventory.title: A home for every code
inventory.body: Generate codes or import them from CSV and Excel. Encrypted at rest, searchable, ready to hand out.

campaigns.title: Deliver on your terms
campaigns.body: Public or private claim links with rules you combine: who, when, how many.

checkout.title: Paid, then delivered
checkout.body: Stripe Checkout sells one code per order, with refunds that can revoke it.

rewards.title: More than a code
rewards.body: Memberships, credits and device-bound licenses come built in.

api.title: Built to connect
api.body: Scoped API tokens, signed webhooks and an MCP server for your backend and AI agents.

own.title: Yours to build on

home.stepsTitle: Up and running in an afternoon

publicSite.toggleTheme: Switch between light and dark mode
publicSite.startBody: Bring your codes, choose your audience, and give your product a way in.
publicSite.featureDescription: Manage access, run giveaways, and deliver product codes after payment.

inventory.title: An organized code library
inventory.body: Generate codes with your own format, or import existing codes from Excel and CSV. Keep redemption, discount, license, and external platform codes together.

campaigns.title: Share with the right people
campaigns.body: Create public campaigns or private links. Combine eligibility rules, set limits, and choose whether people need to sign in.

payments.title: From payment to delivery
payments.body: Sell one code at a time with Stripe Checkout. Reserve stock and choose how to handle refunds and orders that need attention.

rewards.title: Access that fits your product
rewards.body: Offer memberships, permanent access, or credits. Connect software licenses to devices, or send rewards to your own service.

integrations.title: Built to connect
integrations.body: Use scoped API tokens, event webhooks, and MCP to connect your workflow. Your deployment stays under your control.

ownership.title: Make it your own
ownership.body: Start with a self-hosted, MIT-licensed foundation. Adapt the pages, brand, and rules to your product.

docs.label: Guide
docs.title: A simple way to get your code
docs.description: Learn how claiming, buying, and redeeming codes work.

claim.title: Claim a code
claim.body: Open the campaign link shared by the product owner. Follow its eligibility steps and save the code after your claim is confirmed.

buy.title: Buy a code
buy.body: When a product is for sale, review its price before continuing to checkout. Your order page shows delivery progress after payment.

redeem.title: Use your code
redeem.body: Follow the product’s redemption instructions. External platform codes must be redeemed on that platform. If a connected service cannot confirm a reward, wait for the administrator to review it.

pricing.label: Pricing
pricing.title: A price for each product
pricing.description: Review the price and currency shown on the product’s purchase page before you pay.

guestEmail.title: Email a copy of this code
guestEmail.hint: Optional. Enter your own email address and check it carefully: it cannot be changed after submission. To save this claim to an account later, verify this same address. Your code remains available here.

states.pending: Email queued. Delivery will be attempted shortly.
states.sending: Submitting your email to the delivery service.
states.sent: The email service accepted your message. Check your inbox and spam folder.

security.title: Account security
security.description: Manage how you sign in to your account.
security.nameHint: This is the name shown in your account and the dashboard. Up to 100 characters.
security.nameInvalid: Enter a name of 1 to 100 characters without control characters.
security.nameFailed: The name could not be saved. Try again.
security.setHint: Use at least 12 characters. You can keep using email codes after setting a password.
security.changeHint: Use at least 12 characters. Changing your password signs out your other sessions.
security.failed: The password could not be saved. Check your details and try again.
security.reauth: Sign in again before setting a password. A recent sign-in is required.
security.verifyFirst: Verify your email by signing in with an email code before setting a password.
security.alreadySet: A password is already set. Reload this page to change it using your current password.
security.saved: Your password is set. You can now sign in with your email and password.
security.changed: Your password is changed. Your other sessions have been signed out.
security.resetDescription: Use a code sent to your email to choose a new password.
security.resetSent: If an account exists for this email, a reset code has been sent. Check your inbox.
security.resetHint: Use at least 12 characters. Resetting your password signs out all existing sessions.
security.startAgain: Use another email or request a new code
security.resetFailed: The password could not be reset. Check your details and code, or request a new code.
security.rateLimited: Too many attempts. Wait a minute before trying again.
security.resetSuccess: Your password has been reset and all existing sessions signed out. Sign in with your new password.
security.emailUnavailable: Password reset by email is unavailable on this site. Contact the site administrator.
